lenovo - idea tab plus - 12.1\" 2.5k tab.name: Lenovo - Idea Tab Plus - 12.1" 2.5K Tablet - 8GB RAM - 128GB UFS - MediaTek Dimensity 6400 2025 - Tab Pen Plus - Tab Pen Plus - Luna Grey
lenovo - idea tab plus - 12.1\" 2.5k tab.description: Building on Lenovo’s established large-screen tablet heritage, the Idea Tab Plus is a premium AI productivity tablet that combines intelligent AI capabilities, dependable durability, immersive entertainment, and effortless portability in a refined premium design, weighing just 1.17 lbs for easy portability anywhere, with IP52-rated protection that helps guard against dust and everyday splashes, a massive 10200mAh battery that delivers long-lasting power throughout the day, and four speakers optimized with Dolby Atmos that provide rich, immersive sound for work, streaming, and more. It comes with the included Lenovo Tab Pen Plus to unlock a more intuitive way to write, create, and interact, letting you take notes, sketch ideas, annotate documents, and navigate naturally with precise pen input, and its AI-powered features such as Circle to Search and instant translation allow you to quickly discover information, understand content, and explore what's on screen with a simple gesture, so whether capturing inspiration, organizing ideas, or working across languages, the responsive stylus helps make every interaction smoother and more engaging. Equipped with the MediaTek Dimensity 6400 processor and integrated Arm Mali-G57 MC2 Graphics, the Lenovo Idea Tab Plus delivers smooth performance for multitasking and everyday productivity, and it comes with 8GB LPDDR4X memory and 128GB of total storage made up of 128GB built-in UFS storage, providing plenty of room for documents, photos, videos, apps, and more, while the included microSD card offers convenient plug-and-play storage expansion to make it easy to access, organize, and transfer your content whenever needed. It delivers excellent visuals with its 12.1" 2.5K (2560 × 1600) IPS touchscreen featuring up to 800 nits brightness, a fast 90Hz refresh rate, and 96% DCI-P3 color gamut coverage for vivid, true-to-life colors, and whether streaming, browsing, or creating content, the large display renders sharp images and fluid responsiveness, paired with a 13MP rear camera and an 8MP front camera that make it easy to capture moments, scan documents, and stay connected through video calls. For effective connectivity, it keeps you connected with fast Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.2 for reliable wireless performance, its USB-C port supports charging, and you can expand storage with the microSD card slot or pair compatible accessories through the 3-point Pogo Pin connector. Highly versatile for everyday life, the Lenovo Idea Tab Plus is designed to fit seamlessly into daily routines from studying and remote learning to working, reading, web browsing, video streaming, and staying connected with family and friends, ideal for students, professionals, remote workers, frequent travelers, and families as it adapts easily to a wide range of activities including online classes, digital reading, document review, video calls, entertainment, and casual gaming, delivering the flexibility and convenience needed for modern daily life whether at home, in the office, in the classroom, or on the go.
